name: HIST 3330
title: Palestine Under the Greeks and Romans
description: (Also offered as HEJS 3330, CAMS 3330.) The political, historical and religious currents in Greco-Roman Palestine. Includes the Jewish Revolts, sectarian developments, the rise of Christianity and the Talmudic academies. May not be used to meet the foreign language requirement. Taught in English.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
